basic_details.job_title: PRD Kerala Reporter Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Kerala PRD Recruitment 2026 offers one Reporter post on a daily wage basis in the PRD Live App news project of the Information Public Relations Department (Vivara-Pothujanasamparkka Vakuppu), Government of Kerala. Candidates need a Degree/Diploma in Journalism, at least three years of online media experience and live-streaming skills. Applications must be received by 6 November 2026, and can be submitted directly or by post.

how_to_apply: Applications for the Reporter post must be submitted directly or by post so that they are received by 6 November 2026. The address is: Director, Information Public Relations Department, South Block, Government Secretariat, Thiruvananthapuram - 695 001.
The notification says details are available in the What's New section of the kerala.gov.in website and in the Announcement section of the prd.kerala.gov.in website.

content_sections.heading: About Kerala PRD
content_sections.text: The Information Public Relations Department is a department of the Government of Kerala, with its office at South Block, Government Secretariat, Thiruvananthapuram. The PRD Live App news project comes under this department. The notification was issued from Thiruvananthapuram over the name of the Director, Sabin Sameed IAS.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notification lists these qualifications for the Reporter post: Degree/Diploma in Journalism. Not less than three years of work experience in online media. Proficiency in real-time streaming of official programmes on social media platforms. Proficiency in related software. The official notification is the reference for the full eligibility conditions of the Reporter post.
